name: released-objects
description: Flag SAP objects in ABAP code that are not released, deprecated or have no API, with SAP's successor, using SAP's own release lists. It flags, never blocks.

dataDir.title: Folder holding the compact release lists
dataDir.description: Where released-objects-<list>.tsv files live, built from SAP's github.com/SAP/abap-atc-cr-cv-s4hc lists.

defaultList.title: Default SAP release list
defaultList.description: Used when a repository's ABAP version is not mapped: PCELatest (private cloud and on-premise) or Latest (public cloud).

customerLists.title: SAP list per customer folder
customerLists.description: One entry per customer: the folder holding that customer's code, then = and the SAP list for its release, separated by semicolons. Example: ~/code/client-a=PCE2023_3; ~/code/client-b=PCE2022_2. Takes precedence over the version map.

versionMap.title: abaplint version to SAP list
versionMap.description: Pairs such as v816=PCE2023_3, separated by commas. Leave empty until each mapping is confirmed from a cited source.

customerPrefixes.title: Customer name prefixes
customerPrefixes.description: Comma-separated prefixes of your own objects, never flagged.
